title: Effect of osmolytes on the EcoRI endonuclease: Insights into hydration and protein dynamics from molecular dynamics simulations.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究渗透剂对EcoRI限制酶动态和水合作用的影响，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Osmolytes play an important role in cellular physiology by modulating the properties of proteins, including their molecular specificity. EcoRI is a model restriction enzyme whose specificity to DNA is altered in the presence of osmolytes. Here, we investigate the effect of two different osmolytes, glycerol and DMSO, on the dynamics and hydration of the EcoRI enzyme using molecular dynamics simulations. Our results show that the osmolytes, alter the essential dynamics of EcoRI. Particularly, we observe that the dynamics of the arm region of EcoRI which is involved in DNA binding is significantly altered. In addition, conformational free energy analyses reveals that the osmolytes bring about a change in the landscape similar to that of EcoRI bound to cognate DNA. We further observe that the hydration of the enzyme for each of the osmolyte is different, indicating that the mechanism of action of each of these osmolytes could be different. Further analyses of interfacial water dynamics using rotational autocorrelation function reveals that while the protein surface contributes to a slower tumbling motion of water, osmolytes, additionally contribute to the slowing of the angular motion of the water molecules. Entropy analysis also corroborates with this finding. We also find that the slowed rotational motion of interfacial waters in the presence of osmolytes contributes to a slowed relaxation of the hydrogen bonds between the interfacial waters and the functionally important residues in the protein. Taken together, our results show that osmolytes alter the dynamics of the protein by altering the dynamics of water. This altered dynamics, mediated by the changes in the water dynamics and hydrogen bonds with functionally important residues, may contribute to the altered specificity of EcoRI in the presence of osmolytes.
abstract_zh: 渗透调节物（osmolytes）通过调节蛋白质的性质（包括其分子特异性）在细胞生理中发挥重要作用。EcoRI是一种模型限制酶，其DNA特异性在渗透调节物存在时发生改变。在此，我们利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟研究两种不同的渗透调节物——甘油（glycerol）和二甲基亚砜（DMSO）——对EcoRI酶动力学和水合作用的影响。我们的结果表明，渗透调节物改变了EcoRI的必需动力学。特别地，我们观察到参与DNA结合的EcoRI臂区的动力学显著改变。此外，构象自由能分析揭示，渗透调节物引起的景观变化类似于EcoRI与同源DNA结合时的变化。我们进一步观察到，每种渗透调节物下酶的水合作用不同，表明这些渗透调节物的作用机制可能各异。使用旋转自相关函数对界面水动力学的进一步分析显示，蛋白质表面贡献于水的较慢翻滚运动，而渗透调节物额外促进了水分子角运动的减慢。熵分析也证实了这一发现。我们还发现，在渗透调节物存在下，界面水旋转运动的减慢导致界面水与蛋白质中功能重要残基之间氢键的松弛减慢。综合来看，我们的结果表明，渗透调节物通过改变水的动力学来改变蛋白质的动力学。这种由水动力学变化及与功能重要残基的氢键介导的改变动力学，可能有助于EcoRI在渗透调节物存在下特异性的改变。
